title: Account for assets held for sale

items.concept: Initial recognition JE (lower of CA or FV − costs to sell); subsequent measurement schedule; period-end recovery JE; disposal JE; presentation
Number-variant twin — initial HFS write-down, multi-period measurement schedule, recovery JE, disposal with small loss
Multi-asset held-for-sale measurement at reporting date; period-end write-downs and recovery; no depreciation; other-asset presentation
Held-for-sale impairment uses lower of CA or FV less costs to sell (recoverable cost / undiscounted CF is irrelevant)
Cease depreciation; measure at lower of CA or FV − costs to sell; report as other assets
